descriptions.w3d_d29g_geyser_sky_step_8004f238: Geyser sky step: lazily initialises three static vectors, passes two of them to the camera service, moves the 3 by 3 sprite grid at +28 by the scroll vector, advances the two scroll angles with wrap-around, and at random intervals of 500 to 2500 ms starts the Part_Geyser particle at a random position. Returns 20.
